name: AwwO motion language
about: The single source of AwwO's motion vocabulary: MOTION.md explains it; the hosted app's tokens.css, the built-in skills and scripts/motion-lint.mjs are checked against it.

enter.use: anything arriving or settling into place; the default for a state change

move.use: moving between two places that are both on screen; camera moves

emphasis.use: one hero moment at a time, about 5 % overshoot; position and scale only, never opacity or colour

linear.use: only motion that never starts or stops on screen: a spinner, a ticker, a constant drift

uses.fast: press, toggle, hover, confirming a state
uses.base: something small entering: a menu, a popover, a toast
uses.slow: a sheet, a dialog or a drawer; a container changing shape
uses.scene: moving between screens or a staged reveal; the most a UI transition may take

uses.xs: a small element, a tick, a chip
uses.m: a move across the whole frame

snappy.use: toggles, chips, small things a finger moves

sheet.use: sheets, drawers and panels that should feel heavy

land.use: a title or card landing in a film

glide.use: cameras and large containers: no overshoot

character.about: Starting points for a project's own motion language: each overrides the entrance curve and the main move.
